refusal.statement: This session REFUSES to produce a review verdict on the five GOAL-SATIC-c49b77 launch-archive bindings, rather than degrade the requested policy. reasons.fact: On the `local` backend, review-adversarial is UNBOUND: orchestration/model-bindings.yaml line 626 reads `review-adversarial: {model: null, provenance: unbound}`.
reasons.consequence: The adapter's resolver, asked to resolve review-adversarial on the local backend, finds model: null and stops with a named error. It does not serve this model. This session is therefore not a valid resolution of the review-adversarial policy; it was never dispatched as one through the adapter.

reasons.fact: The local backend's qwen3.8-27b declares max_reasoning_effort: high (its honest ceiling; the bindings comment states the effort tier is NOT dialable on this backend and that declaring xhigh/max would be the overstatement the integrity rules forbid).
reasons.consequence: The requested effort is xhigh. In the effort lattice (none < low < medium < high < xhigh < max), high < xhigh. Serving this review would cap the requested xhigh at high, which is a degradation.

reasons.fact: The handoff (ledger/handoffs/TASK-20260905-5681fc.yaml) sets inference.fallback_allowed: false and inference.degraded_allowed: false; the frozen contract and DEC-20260905-ed0e18 both state 'no fallback, no degradation' and 'If the serving session cannot honour the requested policy it must refuse to produce a report; a lower-effort or same-session stand-in is a silent downgrade this approval does not grant.'
reasons.consequence: Even setting aside the unbound binding, the general relaxed-floor policy (weaker backend serves at its ceiling with the cap recorded) is overridden here by the handoff's explicit no-degradation terms. A capped-at-high service is exactly the silent downgrade the approval does not grant.

refusal.independent_session: This session is a fresh session that did not originate the claim (independence of setup is satisfied). Independence, however, is only one of the policy's load-bearing parts; the depth requirement (xhigh) and the valid-resolution requirement are not met by this model, so the policy as a whole is not honoured.
refusal.remedy: Re-dispatch TASK-20260905-5681fc (or a successor) on a backend whose binding actually serves review-adversarial at xhigh with no degradation (e.g. the `anthropic` backend's claude-opus-5, or the `openai` backend's gpt-5.6-sol, both of which declare max_reasoning_effort at or above xhigh and have review-adversarial bound). Keep IMP-1 open until such a review is durable, archived, verified, and published, per DEC-20260905-ed0e18 next_actions.
